# S57 — CMMN engine foundation

17 October 2026. This is the first verified WM04 increment toward the user-selected full CMMN 1.1 target. It does not expose case APIs or close WM04.

The backend now includes Flowable 8.0.0's CMMN Spring Boot starter and its companion configurator beside the existing BPMN and DMN engines. The existing `migrate` profile creates CMMN engine tables in the `flowable` schema as the DDL owner; `MigrationRunner` grants the DML-only application role access after engine initialization. Normal application pods keep `flowable.database-schema-update: false`. The migration job therefore **must run before a new image containing this dependency starts**. The starter adds no public Orqix case endpoint and does not grant callers direct engine access.

The test-only `cases/cmmn-compatibility.cmmn` model uses CMMN 1.1 XML with a human task, a completion sentry that enables a second human task, and a second sentry that reaches a milestone. `CmmnEngineCompatibilityTest` boots the real migrated PostgreSQL test stack, connects as `orqix_app`, deploys the case definition, starts one instance, checks the task ordering, completes both tasks, and checks case completion and historic milestone persistence. This proves engine wiring and a small lifecycle path, not conformance with the complete OMG standard. The fixture uses Flowable's documented CMMN model and API shapes ([Flowable CMMN guide](https://www.flowable.com/open-source/docs/cmmn/ch06-cmmn)); the target standard remains [OMG CMMN 1.1](https://www.omg.org/spec/CMMN/1.1/About-CMMN/).

The first boot attempt identified a missing `flowable-cmmn-spring-configurator` class when only the starter was present. Adding the explicit configurator resolved it; the final test runs through the same migration and runtime role path used by other integration tests. Evidence: `evidence/cmmn-compat-1017.log`. A focused regression with existing BPMN case-stage and architecture checks is recorded separately in `evidence/cmmn-compat-regression-1017.log`.

The final focused regression passes **11/11**: five architecture cases, five existing BPMN case-stage cases, and the new CMMN engine lifecycle case. This closes WM04a, the engine compatibility sub-ticket. It does not verify the full application suite, a refreshed Docker image, public case authorization or complete CMMN semantics.

Next delivery needs workspace-scoped case definition/version storage, strict CMMN import diagnostics, authorization and idempotent case APIs, runtime projections, task eligibility, case data and discretionary planning, a designer and case operations UI, and a conformance matrix across sentries, stages, plan item controls, repetition, listeners, nested cases and termination. Those are required before WM04 can be closed. UI02's full shared-view/action/page delivery is tracked separately in [S56](S56-adaptive-cases-ui-designer-scope.md).
